purpose: Form CHG-9 is used for the registration of creation or modification of a charge relating to debentures.
who: The company and the charge holder, or insolvency resolution professional, resolution professional, or liquidator for companies under resolution or liquidation
when: Within a period of thirty days of the date of creation or modification of charge
steps: Prepare particulars of the charge and a copy of the instrument creating or modifying the charge.

Ensure Form CHG-9 is duly signed by the company and the charge holder, or by the insolvency resolution professional, resolution professional, or liquidator for companies under resolution or liquidation.
File Form CHG-9 with the Registrar along with the fee within thirty days of the date of creation or modification of the charge.
If not filed within thirty days, file within the period specified in section 77 on payment of additional fee or advalorem fee as prescribed.
checklist: Copy of the instrument creating or modifying the charge for debentures
Signatures of the company and the charge holder, or the insolvency resolution professional, resolution professional, or liquidator where applicable
Fee, additional fee, or advalorem fee as applicable
attachments: Copy of the instrument creating or modifying the charge
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
